system.description:
Instantly use one of the Kannagi or Healer skills with [Timing: Setup]. At this time, treat the SR of that skill as being +2 (may exceed the maximum SR). In addition, the skill you use does not count towards its Limit and can even be used if it has no more uses.

A special skill that borrows the spiritual power of powerful souls that are enshrined as gods and uses techniques with power that exceeds limits.
